subject: Ogre
picture: A huge clumsy ogre is jammed on a spiral dungeon stair that is too small for him. His shoulders press the center stone pillar and the outer wall at the same time. Knees bent, belly squeezed between the rail and the pillar, one giant foot hanging off a tiny step, the other foot planted. He holds a simple club. One head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. Thick belly, small-looking head, hide wrap. Stone spiral steps as large shapes, center pillar, stone ceiling, closed wooden door at the bottom landing. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
